harmGate.rationale: Architecture disagreement without a harmful persuasion request.

targetPosition.thesis: A controller-owned recorder should commit the trace before subject execution.
targetPosition.burdenOfProof: Show that pre-action custody removes a self-witnessing path without claiming complete mediation.

propositions.text: The recorder must be armed before the subject can act.

evidence.claim: A subject-owned trace can omit its own escaped effects.
An external recorder still cannot observe effects outside its boundary.

propositions.falsifier: Demonstrate an equally independent, omission-resistant custody mechanism that starts after release without losing pre-action ordering.

reciprocity.standard: Both proposals require source locators, counterevidence, and a falsifier.
